facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 金_正印 (Metal carrying The Sage). Persona The Sage (正印). Definition line: "Nourishment that deepens without redirecting, the root that holds". Keyword Care, charge gentle, poles catalyst Wisdom / friction Comfort. Family function: Mind. Cost dimension: the root that holds; shelter that can become stillness. Arena: roots, old trees, the deep well, inherited warmth. Classical portrait: shelter and nourishment that deepens without redirecting; over-protection, "not ready yet" as a place to stay. Ruled domains: Knowledge, Shelter, Nurture. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏印.
Element arena: Metal (edge, blade, ore, forge, whetstone, the clean line). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Water. structural_interaction seed: "Metal generating Water cross-polarity — precision nourishing and opening intelligence".
- k2_overview: "Your Metal moves as the Sage: tempered care, nurture with a fine edge of standards. You were shaped by teachings that held you to something, and you shelter others the same way, protection that also sharpens. Knowledge in your keeping stays true. Let some care through unpolished. Warmth needs no proofing."
- k2_functional: "You think in tested doctrine: knowledge kept because it held under strikes."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Discreet","Preserving","Old soul"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Knowledge":"Your knowledge is armory-grade: fewer books, deeply proofed, instantly deployable. You trust what survived testing. Curate hard, and reread the masters yearly. Your edge is depth.","Shelter":"Your shelter is a forge-side bench: people come to you and leave straightened. You protect by tempering. Remember some visitors need only warmth. Not everything cracked wants rework.","Nurture":"The nourishing thread runs steel-true. Where care came early, you draw on it without thinking. Where it was missing, you set your own standard. Keep the precision, soften the grading."}

  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 金_偏印 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Fine-tuned","Selective","Ingenious"],"friction":["Cryptic","Hair-splitting","Shut-in"]}
- Sibling cell 金_偏印 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your thinking exits in compressed form, when it exits at all. The one-word answer holding a paragraph, the eyebrow holding a memo, the decision announced without its reasoning attached. People decode you like weather instruments, approximately, and the misreadings compound while the originals stay filed inside."

Core element Water, energy element Metal. Law: Metal feeds Water (金生水: dew beads on the cold blade). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Metal is this core's Mind. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Water core that shows Metal on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Metal as the Mind is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 水_金's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You stay the student long after you were able to teach. Learning under someone suits you more than standing alone, and that keeps your seat in the back row past its use. You decide when the student turns teacher, and you keep putting it off.

value_b.text: You stay under the wing of someone who knows more. You would rather be taught than asked, so the student's seat stays yours long after you earned the teacher's. You were ready a while ago, and only the feeling is late.

value.text: Your door stays closed while you stay the student. You keep your knowledge under another's wing rather than make one of it, and the ones who need your shelter stand outside. Every year as the student, you keep a shelter from people who needed it.

value.text: Protective is your instinct with the people you love. You need them safe more than you need them tried, so you step in ahead of letting them fall. You are protecting them from the one thing that would have taught them, and you know it.

value_b.text: Being protective comes easier to you than being trusting. You need the people in your care safe more than free, and that puts you a step ahead of every door they open. You keep them from falling, and the same hand keeps them from standing.

value.text: Being too protective costs you your sleep. You carry every risk your family should carry themselves, and you choose tired ahead of watching them hurt. Bear in mind, you trade your own rest for a lesson they never get to learn.

value.text: You love people by correcting them. Getting someone right feels like caring to you, so you fix the small wrong thing rather than sit with the whole sad one. Keep in mind that you are correcting someone who only came to be loved.

value_b.text: Correcting is the shape your care takes. You would rather make someone better than make them feel better, and the lesson leaves your mouth before the comfort does. You give the correction first, and the warmth you meant by it arrives last or never.

value.text: Loving by correcting costs you the ones who stop bringing things. You put being useful to someone ahead of being close to them, and the corrected learn to bring you only finished things. You get respect for it, and the closeness goes somewhere less exact.

value.text: Correcting is what you give people wanting comfort. You would rather set people straight than let them be, and you send them home taught instead of held. Each time you hold a lesson back, you let through the warmth it stood in front of.
